title: Module 37 — Cloud Platforms & Certification
description: Learn the transferable cloud skill you can practice with zero cloud account and zero cost: the Infrastructure-as-Code lifecycle with OpenTofu. Write a config, init/plan/apply, inspect the state, simulate drift, and destroy — the exact loop that provisions a real VM, database, or GPU. All work lives in a throwaway ~/iac-lab directory.

steps.title: tofu apply — create it, then inspect the state
